simple.meaning: Kirjath-Jearim or Kirjath-Arim , a place in Palestine
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to קִרְיַת יְעָרִים (H7157) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 19 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: קִרְיַת יְעָרִים (Qiryath Yᵉʻârîym) means Kirjath-Jearim or Kirjath-Arim , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 2 50.

definitions.short: Kirjath-Jearim or Kirjath-Arim , a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H7157. Qiryath Yearim or Qiryath Arim יְעָרִים קִרְיַת proper name, of a location πόλ ( ε ) ις Ιαρειμ[ν] , Καριαθιαρειμ , etc. ( city of forests ); — city of the Gibeonites Josh 9:17 , assigned to Judah 15:60 compare Judg 18:12 (twice in verse), on border of Benjamin Josh 15:9 ( הַר יְעָרִים 15:10 , ᵐ5 πόλιν Ιαρειν , see יְעָרִים ), 18:14 ; assigned to Benjamin 18:28 ( יְעָרִים omitted by textual error before עָרִים , see ᵐ5 ); near Beth Shemesh 1Sam 6:21 , long the abode of ark 7:1-2 , 1Chr 13:5-6 , 2Chr 1:4 ; named in Genealogical list 1Chr 2:50 , 52 , 53 ; named also Neh 7:29 = ׳ק עָרִים Ezra 2:25 (read יְעָרִים ); with article ׳ק הַיְּעָרִים Jer 26:20 ; abbreviated (in poetry) ( שְׂדֵיֿ ) יָ֑עַר Psa 132:6 ; called also קִרְיַתבַּֿעַל ( Καριαθβααλ ) Josh 15:60 ; 18:14 + 18:15 (where read for ׳ק יְעָרִים , so ᵐ5 Di Benn Steuern); this abbreviated into בַּעֲלָה , 15:9-10 , [( Ιε ) βααλ ], also 15:11 ; 15:29 , and יְהוּדָה מִבַּעֲלֵי 2Sam 6:2 (read יְה ׳בַּעַל , or יְה ׳בַּעֲלַת ), בַּעֲלָ֑תָה || 1Chr 13:6 (see on these II. בַּעֲלָה ). Identification uncertain; Rob BR ii. 11 conjectures Kiryat el-`Enab , 8 miles + west of Jerusalem (compare Καριαθιαρειμ Lag Onom. 271 ); `Erma (Henderson Pal. 85, 112, 210 Conder Survey Mem. iii. 43 ff. ), compare GASm Geogr. 225 f. Buhl Geogr. 166 f. . קִרְיַתסַֿנָּה see following ׳ק עָרִים see foregoing
definitions.rootNote: or (Jeremiah 26:20) with the article interposed; or (Joshua 18:28) simply the former part of the word; or קִרְיַת עָרִים ; from 7151 and the plural of 3293 or 5892 ; city of forests, or city of towns;
